name: OpenEarth-Bench
description: Earth Observation (EO) is essential for perceiving dynamic land surface changes, yet deploying autonomous EO in open environments is hindered by the immense diversity of multi-source data and heterogeneous tasks. While remote sensing agents have emerged to streamline EO workflows, existing tool-calling agents are confined to closed environments. They rely on pre-defined tools and are restricted to narrow scope, limiting their generalization to the diverse data and tasks.
